text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync for the AcmeHW + cloud marketplace SI onboarding pilot tomorrow. Need alignment on lab access, cert requirements, announcement constraints.
Carlos Nguyen: Who's in the initial cohort and do they get private GPUs or shared sandboxes?
Maya Patel: Four SIs for the pilot, NA only. Prefer dedicated GPUs for onboarding week.
Priya Desai: We'll need to share network/VPC and firewall expectations ahead of time. Can we produce a short tech one-pager per SI?
Jordan Lee: I'll put together the one-pager and a dry-run checklist. Suggest dry-run 48h before.
Maya Patel: Dry-run Thu 10am PT works. Jordan can you run it?
Jordan Lee: Yep. I'll own the demo script + failure scenarios.
Carlos Nguyen: Ops note: dedicated sandbox provisioning takes ~3 hours after request. ops-bot will post links when ready.
ops-bot: sandbox-provisioner: Request accepted. ETA 3h.
Samira Khan: Certification plan: hands-on lab (pass threshold 70%) + 15-min viva. Badge on pass. Should we include a remediation path?
Maya Patel: Good point. Add a single remediation attempt within a week. Samira, can you author the exam doc?
Samira Khan: I'll drop the draft in the partnerships drive by EOD with remediation details.
Carlos Nguyen: Marketplace requirements checklist:
- Product name and short description for tile
- Pricing tiers + supported regions
- Verified instance types / GPU SKUs
- Security notes (KMS/HSM, SOC, ISO blurbs)
- Support contact and SLAs
Also request SI marketing blurbs for co-branding.
Priya Desai: Add a matrix for Dedicated vs Private (networking and infra differences). I'll upload that sheet.
Maya Patel: For the lab we'll provide a prebuilt model snapshot and a jumpbox. Credentials will be per-SI accounts.
Carlos Nguyen: Access snippet (replace with per-SI creds):
```
ssh redwood-sandbox@34.83.11.55 -i ~/.ssh/redwood_pilot.pem
# then sudo su - labadmin
```
Maya Patel: Reminder: don't re-use PEMs across partners. Use partner-specific keys.
Jordan Lee: Demo flow I'm prepping:
1) Deploy model variant -> 2) Run perf tests + validate latency SLOs -> 3) Trigger failover to fallback model -> 4) Inspect tracing & logs.
Alyssa (marketing): Heads up: marketing signoff required before any joint announcement. Avoid naming SI customers publicly unless legal approves.
Samira Khan: I'll make a certification appeals form and an FAQ for instructors.
Carlos Nguyen: Timeline recap:
- Today: finalize cohort + cert rubric (Samira)
- EOD: submit sandbox requests (Carlos)
- Thu 10am PT: dry-run (Jordan)
- Fri: marketing/legal signoff + marketplace draft (Alyssa)
- Next Tue: pilot workshop
Priya Desai: Uploading a small network validation script to the drive now. Will ping when done.
ops-bot: sandbox-provisioner: 4 sandboxes ready -> https://console.redwood/sandbox/1837 :rocket:
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll send invites + agenda in 30m. Action owners: Samira exam doc, Carlos sandboxes, Jordan dry-run, Priya network tests, Alyssa marketing checklist.
Carlos Nguyen: Creating a short feedback doc for instructors to capture issues during labs.
Jordan Lee: Dry-run invite sent. See you Thu. :eyes:
Maya Patel: Closing loop 12 follow-ups tracked. Let's keep comms here for any last-minute changes.
